title: Lookups across sheets
explanation: In real workbooks, data is split across tabs: orders on one sheet, customers on another, prices on a third. Lookups can reach into another sheet, as long as you say which one. This workbook has 3 sheets: **Orders**, **Customers** and **Tiers**.

tasks.prompt: Click the Customers tab and look at it, then come back to Orders. Click cell A1 on the Customers sheet to continue.
hints: The sheet tabs are at the bottom of the grid.

tasks.prompt: On the Orders sheet, in D2, look up the customer's name from the Customers sheet: =XLOOKUP(B2, Customers!A2:A6, Customers!B2:B6).
tasks.teach: To point at another sheet, write its name, then **!**, then the cells: `Customers!A2:A6`. If a sheet name has a space, wrap it in single quotes: `'Price list'!A2`. You can also just click the other tab while typing the formula, and Excel writes this for you.
hints: Search Customers!A2:A6 for B2, and bring back Customers!B2:B6.

tasks.prompt: Lock the ranges with $ and copy D2 down to D7.
hints: =XLOOKUP(B2, Customers!$A$2:$A$6, Customers!$B$2:$B$6), then copy it down.
Without the $ signs, the ranges slide down and miss customers.
tasks.answer: =XLOOKUP(B2, Customers!$A$2:$A$6, Customers!$B$2:$B$6) in D2, then copy down to D7

tasks.prompt: In E2:E7, look up each customer's tier (the 3rd column on Customers).
hints: Same as the names, but bring back Customers!$C$2:$C$6.
=XLOOKUP(B2, Customers!$A$2:$A$6, Customers!$C$2:$C$6), then copy it down.
tasks.answer: =XLOOKUP(B2, Customers!$A$2:$A$6, Customers!$C$2:$C$6) in E2, then copy down to E7

tasks.prompt: Last one: in F2:F7, look up each tier's discount from the Tiers sheet.
hints: Look up E2 in Tiers!$A$2:$A$3, and bring back Tiers!$B$2:$B$3.
=XLOOKUP(E2, Tiers!$A$2:$A$3, Tiers!$B$2:$B$3), then copy it down.
tasks.answer: =XLOOKUP(E2, Tiers!$A$2:$A$3, Tiers!$B$2:$B$3) in F2, then copy down to F7

recap: To use another sheet in a formula, write SheetName!A1:A10, with single quotes if the name has a space. Lookups across sheets work exactly like lookups on one sheet.
